C1.worst_defect: The home page says what it is and gives two clear CTAs, but never says who should NOT use it or how it compares with the obvious alternative (a hosted POS such as Shopify POS or Square plus a sync); the 'Live demo or your own store' table compares the product with its own demo, not with competitors.
C1.where: home/desktop/02 ('Live demo or your own store' section)

C2.worst_defect: Nobody is named behind the project: no maintainer, company, support channel or production users anywhere, and the only clue is the unexplained third-party domain in 'All it sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com'. The changelog adds to the doubt: three plugin releases in five days (0.1.0 2026-10-01, 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 both 2026-10-06), none since, and a known gap still unpatched ('Not in the release notes: in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder').
C2.where: home/desktop/02 table row 'Sales reach Vendure'; changelog/desktop/01

C3.worst_defect: The path is complete and ordered, with a 'Check it worked' list, but a real store hits workarounds the quick start only mentions in passing: the plugin's own New POS till key role lacks ReadOrder ('add ReadOrder to that role yourself'), and a Dashboard refund 'stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls' in GraphiQL.
C3.where: quick-start text 'Optional: a device key for each till'; plugin-setup 'Settle a Dashboard refund'

C4.worst_defect: The docs are inconsistent between pages: the quick start's run-migrations snippet has `.catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; })` but Plugin setup's 'Run them before starting Vendure' block is a bare `runMigrations(config);` with no error handling. The changelog is internal-jargon heavy ('order.create v5', 'ADR 0005', 'tallyResolveNeedsAdmin(commandId, applied | rejected, note)').
C4.where: plugin-setup/desktop/01 last code block vs quick-start/desktop/02 first code block; changelog/desktop/01

C5.worst_defect: After the two boxed proof cards, 'What it does today' falls back to eight plain heading+paragraph pairs and 'Before you start' is a seven-bullet wall of grey text. The lower half of the home page has no visual rhythm and reads like a docs page, not a product page. Dark mode holds up.
C5.where: home/desktop/01 bottom to home/desktop/02 'Before you start'

C6.worst_defect: On the phone the hero screenshot is cropped to two product cards and cuts the category chips mid-word ('Gif'), so it shows little of a sale. The rest reads well: the comparison table stacks into labelled rows and code wraps without overflow.

C7.worst_defect: Docs page titles are generic, e.g. 'Overview | VendurePOS', which says nothing about point of sale or Vendure in a search result. Otherwise Lighthouse is 97-98/100/100/100, and llms.txt, the sitemap, the search API, the share card and the 404 page are all good.

overall_worst.defect: A client asking 'who maintains this, and who do I call when the till stops selling?' finds no answer. No maintainer, organisation, support route or reference users are named. The only outside party mentioned is 'ph.wcpos.com', which is never explained. The plugin also has had no release for six weeks, while the docs carry a known role gap ('this role has no ReadOrder'). That combination makes it look like an unbacked side project.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/02 (table and footer 'MIT licensed. Built with TallyUI.'); changelog/desktop/01
overall_worst.fix: Add one short 'Who builds this' block to the home footer or Overview. It should name the maintainer or organisation, say what wcpos.com is, and give a support or issue channel with expected response. Ship a 0.3.1 that adds ReadOrder to the till role, so the changelog shows maintenance after the launch week.
